data.one_liner: Open email applications and compose pre-filled emails on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin to query installed email applications, launch the default or a specific email app, and compose emails with pre-filled content like recipients, subject, and body. It features a built-in picker dialog to handle multiple installed mail apps seamlessly.
use_when: Your app needs to open the user's email client to send feedback or contact support
You want to pre-fill email recipients, subjects, and bodies from within your Flutter app
avoid_when: You need to send emails directly from the app server-side without opening an external mail client
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS cross-platform
Allows querying available email apps and handling multiple options with a picker dialog
Supports pre-filling recipients, CC, BCC, subjects, and body text
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of URL schemes in iOS Info.plist
iOS has no attachment support due to platform limitations
data.setup_notes: Android requires no extra setup, but iOS requires declaring email app URL schemes under LSApplicationQueriesSchemes in Info.plist.
